name: The Franco Company
old_description: The Franco Company is a custom furnishing company. We provide made to order pieces of furniture and Art. Our products are hand made in Dallas, TX. We take pride in working providing custom detail to each of our clients and enjoy the one on one interactions with them to create the perfect design.
about:
Founded in 2015 and based in Rowlett, Texas, The Franco Company operates as a custom furnishing business producing made-to-order furniture and art. The company's workshop is located in the Dallas area, where each piece is handcrafted to client specifications.

The company specializes in custom handcrafted furniture, millwork, conference tables, and reception desks for both residential and commercial settings. Materials include solid wood, exotic veneers, high-end laminates, and steel, combined with modern fabrication technology. Every product is built to individual requirements, from statement coffee tables to collaborative workspace solutions.

Clients span commercial offices, hospitality venues, and interior design firms. Notable commercial projects include the American Airlines Center, AT&T Discovery District, and Marriott Hotels. Design-firm partners include Erin Sander Design, Marly & Co, SJL Design, Angeline Guido Design, and Autumn Cooper Design. Local hospitality accounts feature Lochlands Irish Pub, Revolving Kitchen, Fortunate Sons, and Recess Dallas.

The Franco Company emphasizes its use of premium materials and current technology as differentiators, stating that solid wood, exotic veneers, high-end laminates, and real steel set its work apart. The firm also highlights one-on-one client collaboration to ensure each piece reflects the customer's unique needs.
